asks: Have you seen me before tonight?
description: Somebody is standing there in a long coat, and the coat is doing all of the work. There's a collar and there are cuffs and there's a person-shaped amount of dark between them, and it's standing the way a person stands.
emotes: {it} shifts its weight, and the coat resettles a half-second after it.
{it} puts its hands in its pockets, which takes longer than it should.
{it} turns the collar up against a draught you can't feel.
looks: The coat is buttoned to the throat and holds its shape without much help from inside it.
The cuffs hang empty and move when the rest of it does, a moment later.
You can see the wall through the gap at the front, and the wall is behaving normally.
name: a person who's mostly a coat
says: It's colder than it looks out there.
I would take this off but I'm not sure what happens then.
You keep looking at the sleeves.
